page_title: TOU 2-2 REN | Toulouse v Rennes 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
90+3' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
90+1' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Corner kicks – 4:7.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
85' 2 - 2 Goal! Aron Donnum (Toulouse) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Brice Samba into the bottom right corner.
84' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
84' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Toulouse!
84' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Toulouse as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
83' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Rennes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A penalty is given to Toulouse!
82' Toulouse control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
80' Substitution. Frank Magri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Casseres leaves the pitch and Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) comes on.
80' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Esteban Lepaul is replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Przemyslaw Frankowski departs the field of play to be replaced by Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
78' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' Brice Samba (Rennes) gets a yellow card.

74' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
72' 53:47 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
71' Here is a change. Djaoui Cisse is going off and Habib Beye gives the last tactical orders to Glen Kamara (Rennes).
70' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
69' Here's the change. Mohamed Meite leaves the pitch and Breel Embolo (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
67' Shots on target – 2:4.
67' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
63' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
62' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
61' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Sauer (Toulouse) replacing Abu Francis.
61' Substitution. Djibril Sidibe will be replaced by Emersonn (Toulouse).
58' 1 - 2 Goal! Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) takes a short pass from Yann Gboho in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
57' Toulouse are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

54' 0 - 2 Mousa Tamari (Rennes) scores a goal from medium range. He finds some space to collect a pass and produces a low drive that goes inside the net. The goalkeeper couldn't make a save, despite the ball going into the middle of the goal.
52' The Toulouse players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 0:1.
48' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Guillaume Restes (Toulouse).
48' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
45+2' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) leaps to collect the ball.
44' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
42' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
38' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
35' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' It should have been a goal! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
31' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
24' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Wonderful movement by Rennes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
18' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Referee Clement Turpin reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
16' Celebrations by Toulouse are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
15' One of the Rennes players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A penalty is awarded to Toulouse!
11' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
7' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Guillaume Restes leaps to intercept the corner kick from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes).
4' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Rennes as they win a corner.
1' Toulouse enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
